subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Counting (integrated with number patterns and mental maths)
source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 1s from any number between 0 and 110 (weeks 1-2), 120 (weeks 3-4), 140 (weeks 5-8) and 150 (weeks 9-10)

show.line: Ninety-eight, ninety-nine, one hundred! And we keep going. One hundred and one, one hundred and two, one hundred and three.

rounds.prompt: Count on. Ninety-seven, ninety-eight, ninety-nine. What comes next?
Look at this number. Say it.
Count on. One hundred and eight, one hundred and nine. What comes next?
Which number comes just before one hundred and twenty?
rounds.praise: One hundred and nineteen, then one hundred and twenty.

rounds.prompt: Count backwards. One hundred and two, one hundred and one, one hundred. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Ninety-nine! Going down from one hundred.

rounds.prompt: Tap the number one hundred and fourteen.

hints: After one hundred, say one hundred and then count on. And one, and two, and three.
Say the numbers slowly. Listen to the number before.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count on from one hundred and ten.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One hundred and ten, one hundred and eleven, two hundred!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! After one hundred and eleven comes one hundred and twelve.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. One hundred and ten, eleven, twelve. One hundred and twelve!

parent_line: Can count on and back past 100, up to 150.
